name: STEVE (Space-Time-Enclosing Volume Extraction)
definition: A 4D protomesh-based iso-hypersurface construction algorithm that generates iso-hypersurfaces from 4D volumetric data by transforming boundary cube octants into tetrahedrons, handling topological ambiguities to prevent accidental rifts.
summary: STEVE is a 4D protomesh-based algorithm that extracts iso-hypersurfaces by continuously transforming boundary octants into tetrahedrons, avoiding the massive lookup tables of template-based methods.
